Four production lines plus Western Union and passport-photo walk-ins - many interrupt-driven tasks at one counter

top_opportunities.evidence: Home page has no service text; the only form is Name/Email/Message with no specs, and services are one flat list.

top_opportunities.evidence: Title is just 'Downtown Printing Center' with no description or h1; 'Services' page title names neither the service nor New Brunswick.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Quote-desk AI agent that reads incoming email and form requests, prices repeat jobs and drafts replies for staff approval

scores.reasons: Gap 5: the website does not sell - no offer text, no quote path, 2022 copyright. Ability 3: 40-year-old shop with four product lines and a retail counter, so budget exists but is likely modest. Ease 4: a quote-first rebuild is well-trodden work. Evidence 5: every page observed directly.

caveats: Ratings and review counts come from third-party mirrors of Google data (Birdeye, Loc8NearMe, Dispenza, WeedDispos). I did not open Google Maps itself, so treat exact numbers as indicative; the batch's own source URLs were used wherever they carried data.
Claimed/unclaimed status shown on Birdeye reflects Birdeye's own profile, not Google Business Profile ownership, and should not be read as proof that a GBP is unclaimed.
For the four auto shops there is no owned website, so the website review reflects absence rather than quality.
Cannabis sites sit behind mandatory 21+ gates; content was still present in the page HTML and readable, so those businesses were judged on that content rather than on the gate.
Where a business is marked operating without recent first-party activity (auto shops, last visible review 2022), that is an inference from live directory listings, not a direct confirmation.
data_gaps: No phone number in the batch for any of the four auto repair shops; numbers found only on directories, and they conflict for Freddy Auto Repair (two different numbers).
No Google Maps listing could be opened directly for the auto shops, so their Google ratings and review counts are unverified mirrors.
The Street Monkey Auto Repair LLC: only one record found, marking it permanently closed with zero reviews; no way to confirm whether it ever operated as a distinct business.
Puffin Store NJ: the reported 5.0 rating with a review count in the thousands comes from a single aggregator and looks implausible; not verified.
White Lotus Home: the appointment widget is a custom in-house module; I could not tell whether it failed from a configuration gap or a bug, only that no slots were returned.
White Lotus Home: the 'Get a Quote' and 'Call Me Back' tabs on /appointments/ did not render form fields in the DOM, so their field quality is unknown.
White Lotus Home hours conflict: the site footer says Mon-Fri 9:00-17:00, a directory says 9:00-16:00; neither was cross-checked against Google.
Minor Fine Jewelry: the site lists two phone numbers and only WhatsApp for written contact, so I could not confirm team size or whether any staff member handles intake.
